title: 第五章 我们不一样第六章 英雄联盟城际邀请赛
lines: “你笑什么，你们学校男女比例多少，隔壁二刘考了个大专，三天两头带女朋友回来，你呢，让你办的住校办了没有！”张春盯着李牧，但凡听到第二个答案，感觉小李就要gameover。
那个全家都期盼的韩国佬并没有再来，李牧也侥幸的考上了沪东政法大学，过两天开学就是大四了。
“办了，办了，明天开学我就要搬宿舍去住了，老妈你会想我的。”以前为了省钱，李牧是走读的，可眼瞅着毕业张春着急了，住校才能有更多跟女生交流的机会。
“滚，李牧我跟你说，要是带不回女朋友，你就别回来了！”张春恶狠狠的盯着自己的儿子。
“妈，你儿子在学校超受欢迎，我只是宁缺毋滥罢了。”李牧忍不住辩解了一下，看玩笑，自己怎么会没人喜欢呢，这关乎到一个“男人”的尊严！
老李偷偷竖起大拇指，“那当然，跟你爹一样帅，不过这次我是站你妈这边的，没女朋友就别回来了，记得找个漂亮又不要房的，这几年房价涨得不当人啊……”
“哎，当年的国际友人怎么就不来了呢，帮我把贷款也还了多好……”老妈有点怀念了，“老李，要不你明天上街逛逛看看还有没有……”
老李和小李连忙把脸埋进碗里，那样的二傻子百年难遇，这是能守株待兔的吗？
就这样第二天一大早，李牧就被老妈撵走了，而且他的电脑都没让带，用老妈的逻辑，没有女朋友的人是没有资格拥有电脑的。
沪东政法大学，坐落在美丽的松江大学城，在欧式风格的校园里到处洋溢着青春和希望，这里拥有华东地区最好的法学院，同时又是恋爱圣地，女生比例超过3:2，李牧同学现在是一名大四学生，经济法专业，如果硬要给个标签的话，那就是……单身狗。
男生宿舍，396寝室，这是李牧被分到的地方，正好有一个空床位，老妈忍痛给出的住宿费，要是找不到女朋友可能真回不去了。
396的三人都是一个班的，平时一起打篮球关系就很好，提着箱子顶开门，“哥几个，我来报道了！”
寝室里立刻响起了歌声，“我们不一样，不一样，整个寝室只有你没有女朋友，我们在这里，在这里等你……”
紧跟着一通爆笑，很显然李牧住宿舍的梗已经被某人泄露了。
“司马仪，这个碎嘴婆，我就知道你的嘴把不住门！”李牧悔啊，就不应该跟他说。
司马仪，上海土著，自诩情圣，风流潇洒，三年换了三个女朋友，据说是拆二代，家里几套房。
“嘿嘿，牧哥，想让兄弟们闭嘴，就得表示表示，我们已经决定推选你当寝室长了，你懂的。”司马仪挤眉弄眼的坏笑道。
“懂，第一个月的卫生我负责还不行，后面咱们每个周轮流！”李牧无奈的耸耸肩，这帮损友啊。
“牧哥，大气，就这么着了，我说什么来着，我们宿舍老大非牧哥莫属！”
“牧哥，别听他们瞎咧咧，我也没有女朋友。”小白放下书笑道。
“不是吧，小白，你那青梅竹马的女朋友不是今年到我们学校做交换生吗，啧啧，还是出口转内销的小学妹，期待啊！”司马仪笑道，这家伙的嘴已经是一绝了，真不知道女孩子怎么就会喜欢。
“不是女朋友，是以前的邻居，我也好几年没见了。”小白微微一笑，这才是真正的帅。
小白，北京人，19岁，班里最小的，也是最帅的，喜欢篮球、唱歌，据说以前高中的时候还出过专辑，是整个经济法系公认的小嫩草，让小姐姐们流口水的小鲜肉，而且性格温柔，李牧要是女的肯定也喜欢这样的。
“小白，哪天你需要女朋友这种生物，我贴个公告，绝对从我们宿舍排到食堂。”胖乎乎的范建国笑眯眯的说道，“用不了的，兄弟们也可以沾沾光嘛”。
范建国，江西吉安人，透着一种文化气息，最喜欢看lol直播和网络小说，女朋友在江西，两人异地恋。
“奶奶的，学校这破网明天才能开，不能玩，连个直播都不能看，国哥，最近有没有发现有趣的直播网站？”司马仪翘着二郎腿问道。
“有吧，斗鱼啊，天王啊，龙猫一堆，冒出七八个新的，不过都不是你要的那种。”范建国耸耸肩。
“歧视，你们听到了没有，我要的是哪种，***什么的我都不认识，难道喜欢美女就是犯罪嘛，国哥，熟归熟，一样告你诽谤的！”司马仪甩着小辫子说道。
“别贫了，去网吧，还是迎新？”
如果不是等李牧，他们两个早就去排位了，当然所谓迎新其实就是去看学妹。
这个李牧知道，政法大学对游戏的接触比其他学校要慢一些，好像司马仪和范建国也是大二才开始玩的，也不知道水平如何。
“网吧就算了，我们去迎新吧，今年就要毕业了，留下点回忆也好。”小白说道，他的生活就是篮球、音乐和打工，对游戏什么的也没兴趣。
“行，迎新就迎新，顺便物色一下有没有漂亮清纯的学妹，最后一年是要抓紧看看。”司马仪忽然也来了精神。
寝室三人面面相觑，“这么猛，你不怕小薰知道直接eq二连盖大招灭了你？”范建国做了一个封喉的动作。
“我是大射手座！”司马仪一副理所当然的说道，“一个热爱美，热爱浪漫的伟大星座，这只是我作为学长的关爱，是你们的思想太污秽！”
“行了，一起一起，在扯下去就只剩下学弟了，gogogo！”李牧当机立断拖着众人，关键是他还单身呢，老妹儿是没什么可能了，都成精了，但愿有个善良的学妹可怜可怜他，凑合着收留一下。
content_en:
"What are you laughing at? What is the male-to-female ratio in your school? The second Liu next door got admitted to a junior college and brought his girlfriend back every three days. What about you, have you done the dormitory you were asked to do?" Zhang Chun stared at Li Mu. When he heard the second answer, he felt that Xiao Li was about to game over.
The Korean guy that the whole family was looking forward to did not come again. Li Mu was lucky enough to be admitted to Hudong University of Political Science and Law, and he will be a senior when school starts in two days.
"It's done, it's done. I will move into the dormitory when school starts tomorrow. Mom, you will miss me." In order to save money, Li Mu was a day student in the past, but when he saw graduation, Zhang Chun became anxious. Living on campus would give him more opportunities to communicate with girls.
"Go away, Li Mu, I'm telling you, if you can't bring your girlfriend back, don't come back!" Zhang Chun stared at his son fiercely.
"Mom, your son is very popular in school. I'd rather be lacking than being extravagant." Li Mu couldn't help but defend himself. He was joking, how could no one like him? This is about the dignity of a "man"!
Lao Li secretly gave a thumbs up, "Of course, he is as handsome as your father, but this time I am on your mother's side. If you don't have a girlfriend, don't come back. Remember to find someone who is beautiful and doesn't need a house. The housing prices have increased so much in recent years..."
"Hey, why don't my international friends from back then come here? It would be great to help me repay the loan..." Mom felt a little nostalgic, "Lao Li, why don't you go shopping tomorrow to see if there are any..."
Old Li and Xiao Li hurriedly buried their faces in the bowl. Such fools rarely come across in a century. Can they just wait and see?
Just like that, Li Mu was kicked out by his mother early the next morning, and he was not allowed to take his computer with him. According to his mother's logic, people without girlfriends are not qualified to own computers.
Hudong University of Political Science and Law is located in the beautiful university town of Songjiang. The European-style campus is filled with youth and hope. It has the best law school in East China and is also a mecca for love. The ratio of girls is more than 3:2. Li Mu is now a senior student majoring in economic law. If I had to give him a label, it would be... a single.
Boys' dormitory, dormitory 396, this is the place where Li Mu was assigned. There happened to be an empty bed. My mother reluctantly paid for the accommodation. If she couldn't find a girlfriend, she might not be able to go back.
The three members of 396 are all in the same class. They usually have a good relationship playing basketball together. They held the box and opened the door, "Brothers, I'm here to report!"
A song immediately sounded in the dormitory, "We are different, different. You are the only one in the dormitory without a girlfriend. We are here, waiting for you here..."
A burst of laughter followed, and it was obvious that the story about Li Mu living in the dormitory had been leaked by someone.
"Sima Yi, you talkative bitch, I know you can't hold your tongue!" Li Muhui, you shouldn't have told him.
Sima Yi, a native of Shanghai, claims to be a lover, a romantic, and has had three girlfriends in three years. It is said that he has torn down the second generation and several apartments in his house.
"Hey, Brother Mu, if you want the brothers to shut up, you have to express it. We have decided to elect you as the dormitory leader, you know." Sima Yi winked and said with a smirk.
"I understand. I'm not responsible for the hygiene in the first month. From now on, we'll take turns every week!" Li Mu shrugged helplessly, what a bunch of bad friends.
"Brother Mu, you are so grand. What can I say? The boss of our dormitory is none other than Brother Mu!"
"Brother Mu, don't listen to them, I don't have a girlfriend either." Xiaobai put down the book and said with a smile.
"No, Xiaobai, didn't your childhood sweetheart girlfriend come to our school as an exchange student this year? Tsk tsk, she's also a primary school girl who exports to domestic sales. I look forward to it!" Sima Yi said with a smile. This guy's mouth is already very good. I really don't know how girls like it.
"It's not my girlfriend, it's my former neighbor. I haven't seen her for several years." Xiaobai smiled slightly, this is the real handsomeness.
Xiaobai, a native of Beijing, is 19 years old. He is the youngest in the class and the most handsome. He likes basketball and singing. It is said that he even released an album in high school. He is recognized as a young man in the entire economic law system, a young man who makes young ladies drool. He also has a gentle personality. If Li Mu were a woman, she would definitely like this too.
"Xiao Bai, if you need a girlfriend someday, I will put up a notice and you will definitely line up from our dormitory to the cafeteria." The chubby Fan Jianguo said with a smile, "If you can't use it, brothers can also take advantage of it."
Fan Jianguo is from Ji'an, Jiangxi Province. He has a cultural atmosphere. He likes to watch lol live broadcasts and online novels. His girlfriend is in Jiangxi and they are in a long-distance relationship.
"Grandma, the school's broken network won't be open until tomorrow. You can't play, you can't even watch the live broadcast. Brother Guo, have you found any interesting live broadcast websites recently?" Sima Yi asked with her legs crossed.
"Yes, there are Douyu, Heavenly King, and Totoro. There are seven or eight new ones popping up, but they are not the ones you want." Fan Jianguo shrugged.
"Discrimination, have you heard about it? What kind of person do I want? I don't know anything about women. Is it a crime to like beautiful women? Brother Guo, if you are familiar with me, I will sue you for defamation!" Sima Yi said, shaking her pigtails.
"Stop being poor and go to an Internet cafe or welcome new students?"
If they hadn't been waiting for Li Mu, the two of them would have gone to the rankings long ago. Of course, the so-called welcome was actually to see the junior girls.
Li Mu knew that the University of Political Science and Law was slower than other schools to be exposed to games. It seemed that Sima Yi and Fan Jianguo only started playing in their sophomore year, and they didn't know what their level was.
"Forget it at the Internet cafe, let's go to welcome the new students. We will graduate this year, so we might as well leave some memories." Xiaobai said. His life consists of basketball, music and part-time work, and he is not interested in games or anything else.
"Okay, let's welcome the new year. By the way, we'll look for any beautiful and pure school girls. It's our last year to take a look." Sima Yi suddenly became energetic.
The three people in the dormitory looked at each other, "It's so fierce. Aren't you afraid that if Xiaoxun knows it, he will kill you with his double-eq big move?" Fan Jianguo made a throat sealing motion.
"I am a Sagittarius!" Sima Yi said matter-of-factly, "A great zodiac sign that loves beauty and romance. This is just my care as a senior, but your thoughts are too dirty!"
"Okay, let's get together. After this, only the juniors are left, gogogo!" Li Mu made a quick decision and dragged everyone. The key is that he is still single. There is no chance for the old girl. She has become a sperm. I hope there is a kind junior girl who will take pity on him and take care of him.
